checks.description: Starting a level clears pointer-capture history
Continuously denied pointer capture never auto-pauses gameplay
Capture denial explains the middle-mouse camera fallback
Fallback notification is not repeated over later gameplay notices
Brief capture below stability threshold does not arm loss-based pause
Stable capture arms normal loss-of-capture protection
Transient loss within grace period keeps gameplay running
Loss after stable capture and grace period opens pause menu
Resume clears previous capture history and resumes the simulation
Denied capture after resume does not create an endless pause loop
Uncaptured mouse movement without middle button does not rotate camera
Middle-button dragging rotates camera without pointer capture
Paused camera also ignores uncaptured middle-button motion
